old_sentence_or_table_line: Representative failures expose different layers.
A deterioration draft can correctly observe low oxygen saturation yet wrongly call ordinary indicators red flags; source traceability cannot rescue that inference.
A CRP discussion can correctly reject a single-test decision while inventing a testing interval absent from the retrieved guidance.
Auditors also make errors: in one deterioration review, both treated the treatment framework as requiring a red flag, overlooking its alternative of two or more non-red-flag factors or indicators.
An incomplete stopping case can omit a conjunctive criterion despite a genuine citation.
Missing-result cases can drift into reassurance.
Withholding reduces answer availability, and auditor agreement alone does not resolve shared interpretive errors.
Latency is not reported as a model-quality result because archived operational timings mix provider waits, new calls and replayed steps.
